title: Preflight before any key ceremony
summary: Runnability is proven before an authorization challenge can exist.
invariants: Artifact must already be signed, checked and deployed.
Data must be authorised and available with a manifest hash.
Runtime, sandbox and target must be available; target must be eligible.
Test plan commands come from an operator-controlled test-plan identity.
Runtime and WLU limits must fit sandbox policy.
Failed preflight creates no run/authorization journal state.
